Type: open bedside table
Use: bedside surface and shelf for books; bedroom
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: engineered wood, wenge laminate finish
Colors: very dark brown, near black
Shape: low rectangular box, flat top, deep top rail, single open lower shelf, no drawers, plinth sides to floor, compact and blocky
Feel: simple, practical, grounded
Goes with: white walls, light grey or beige bedding, light floors; modern or minimalist bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand - Solimo Spacey Engineered Wood Open Bedside Table (Wenge Finish)
product.description: Engineered wood bedside table that has undergone more than 15 safety and quality tests Material: European Standard Particle Board Smooth edges for protection against scrapes and cuts Sturdy bedside table with a shelf load capacity of 8 kg Tested for resistance against humidity, stains and hot water Free from harmful carcinogens like lead, formaldehyde and pentachlorophenol (PCP) Comes with a 3-year warranty on manufacturing defects
